purpose: Diagnose why retained records acquired after the PSI0G-D8 cutoff do not produce eligible post-cutoff operational primitives.

cutoff.semantics: strict event-time boundary inherited unchanged from PSI0G-D8 and PSI0H-A/B

findings.finding: The 4843 records observed after cutoff contain only address-history and transaction-verification observations. They verify or recover historical activity and are not new launch, transfer, funding, activation, or behavioural events.

All 86847 primitives were generated after cutoff, but none has an event window after cutoff. PrimitiveEngine derives observation windows from underlying event timestamps; generated_at is processing lineage, not operational event time.

The Watchtower and 3SW2 stores are bounded shadow recovery corpora. Their recovery runners explicitly perform a one-shot PrimitiveEngine.run_once after importing frozen historical populations or bounded historical address pages. They are not continuous prospective collectors.

The configured production evidence_writer is autostart=false and its normalization and primitive-engine flags are both disabled. Acquisition retention remains a separate path; it does not populate these shadow corpora with normalized, operation-level primitives.
PSI0G-B is a query-only, one-shot derivation over already-retained primitives and hard-binds source file identity. It cannot serve as an incremental prospective primitive producer.

cause.primary: No qualified path continuously retains genuinely new operational event families, normalizes them, derives primitives using their event timestamps, and appends them to an isolated prospective cohort store.
not_causes: lack of post-cutoff acquisition or processing timestamps

prohibited_repairs: Use acquired_at, observed_at, committed_at, or generated_at as a substitute for an older underlying event timestamp
Relabel historical transaction verification or address-history recovery as prospective operational behaviour
Modify the D8 cutoff or weaken PSI0H-A/B eligibility
Start the production evidence writer, enable mirroring, normalization, primitive derivation, monitoring, alerts, or any provider work under PSI0H-C authority

smallest_legitimate_next_boundary.scope: Qualify a bounded, isolated prospective operational-evidence capture and derivation path.
requirements: Freeze a small post-authorization observation interval and operation-neutral eligibility contract.

Retain genuinely new event-time LaunchFact, TransactionFact, AccountParticipationFact, InstructionFact, and other evidence families required by the existing PrimitiveEngine; do not manufacture absent fields.
Normalize and derive into a new isolated prospective store, leaving the D8 baseline and EP3 shadow corpora immutable.
Prove each eligible primitive window is anchored to its underlying event time and begins strictly after 1786109860.
Bind acquisition, normalization, evidence-to-primitive lineage, replay digests, exclusions, and completeness gaps end to end.
Stop after a bounded cohort is frozen; perform no comparison, alerting, monitoring activation, policy, ranking, identity attribution, or production publication.
smallest_legitimate_next_boundary.authority_needed: A separate explicit authorization is required before production observation, provider traffic, service activation, or production configuration changes. Safe-local work may only define and test the isolated contract with fixtures.
